Dear Ada,

I miss you so much already. The ship is cold and the nights are long, and I keep thinking about our last evening together in the sauna by the harbour.

You looked so beautiful in the warm light. When you kissed me, a shiver ran down my spine and my breath caught. We held each other close, and what happened next is just for us to remember. Later that night we walked home under the stars, and I knew I was the luckiest woman alive.

I love you more than words can say. I can't wait to be home again.

All my love,
Margot
